draft_findings.finding: 120 is the number of sequence-generation calls, while generate_source_only calls the neural model once per autoregressive token step.
draft_findings.requested_fix: Rename to generation_calls or sum receipt.step_count across both passes for actual neural forward calls.

draft_findings.finding: Draft calls code_guard but does not itself require its exact own script path and source hash to be in the pin population. Native parent pins whatever the request lists; the helper should explicitly require its own entry.
draft_findings.requested_fix: Bounded snapshot own script and assert its exact request pin before operation imports.

draft_findings.finding: Already-loaded product modules would not pass through the new SourceFileLoader patch. A fresh interpreter is intended but should be checked in the worker.
draft_findings.requested_fix: Reject preloaded product/workspace modules and optionally verify final canonical product origins correspond to recorded checked-buffer executions; allow explicitly identified natural namespaces.

draft_findings.finding: Each output is fsynced and read back when saved, but the draft does not yet enforce exact export filenames and full final file identities/hashes after all replay/scoring.
draft_findings.requested_fix: Retain every saved output identity and recheck exact expected export inventory with bytes/hash/full physical identity before summary and return.

draft_findings.finding: 16384 MiB is a worker address-space RLIMIT, not evidence that the native scheduler admitted that memory budget. The native owner samples owner+child RSS separately.
draft_findings.requested_fix: Bind or explicitly name the worker AS/CPU policy versus frozen native memory/timeout grant, and avoid claiming kernel containment.

draft_findings.finding: The draft deliberately raises unfrozen adapter API; numerical execution must wait for the final public compatibility contract and its source/test review.
draft_findings.requested_fix: Fill against the finalized pinned API, preserving original generated IDs/receipt bytes and exact codec without manufacturing relational roles or bindings.

scope: source and AST only; source-only review is not numerical execution, native admission or runtime qualification
unsupported_claims: No actual numerical run or model loading was performed by this reviewer.
No native resource admission or closeout was observed.
No source-fidelity accuracy, independent holdout, training improvement, richer relational compatibility or Lean result is established.
Existing native validation profile is sampled isolated-process-group accounting, not a filesystem quota or containment of arbitrary descendants.
Receipt structure alone does not authenticate numerical execution.

viable_minimal_route.child_profile: New explicitly numerical checked-source profile permits installed Torch/NumPy, reuses unchanged bounded nofollow bootstrap/file/directory utilities, and refuses download/encoder SDKs, network attempts and additional processes. Do not reuse the old no-model FORBIDDEN_ROOTS guard unchanged.
viable_minimal_route.generation: Admit existing retained parents and donors using their existing owners; select exactly two primary exposed rows plus two auxiliary legacy training diagnostics. Five variants times three source interventions times four selected rows produces 60 first-pass sequences; load fresh private models and replay all 60 exactly before scoring.
viable_minimal_route.native_owner: Existing run_owned_validation.py and ValidationResourceReservation only. One isolated direct numerical child is attached behind the existing startup barrier. Native lease, memory/process/storage observations, cleanup, durability inventory and release stay under the unchanged native owner.
viable_minimal_route.output: Exclusive bounded writes with fsync/readback, final exact expected output filename population, full physical identity plus bytes/hash rechecks, and final native parent durability seal after the group stops.
viable_minimal_route.source_custody: Intercept SourceFileLoader.get_code for every fixed owned-checkout Python path including private spec_from_file_location aliases, compile the exact bounded source snapshot, retain strong code-object references and audit execution binding. Keep ordinary import discovery. Third-party distribution/binary integrity is outside this claim.
viable_minimal_route.targets: Parent admission reads reference-bearing files. The narrow guarantee is that no source text/reference enters the numerical generate_source_only API and that all first-pass and fresh-replay generations complete before reference scoring.
